scope: Proposition 7.1 (Uniform gap) of the manuscript “Weak pure infiniteness and O-infinity absorption” (preprints/Weak-pure-infiniteness-and-O-infinity-absorption-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 303 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2de287a58acb7170), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant γ > 0 such that no unital exact C∗-algebra B contains a contraction v with the following property: for every integer d ≥ 1 and every contraction D ∈ Md(C), there are a unital representation π : B → B(Hπ) and an isometry J : Cd → Hπ satisfying ∥π(v)J − JD∥ < γ, ∥π(v)∗ J − JD∗ ∥ < γ. (7.1) The representation and the isometry are allowed to depend on d and D.
